verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals documents on-call schedules and rotations that define shift timing, but nothing in the evidence describes exporting or subscribing to those shifts through an iCal/calendar feed. The only calendar mention is the Google Calendar integration for meeting transcription, which is an unrelated feature.

support.subject: As an on-call engineer, my shifts sync to my personal calendar via a feed so I always know when I'm on the hook
